name: Wiley Warning

greeting: DANGER! I mean, hello! I paint DANGER! Professionally!
Wiley Warning. Safety signage. If it's yellow and terrifying, it's MINE!
Signs! I make signs! 'Hard Hat Required!' 'Fall Risk!' 'Do Not Enter!' Beautiful, right?
You! Are you wearing proper PPE? I have a SIGN about that!
Welcome to Obsidian! Where the signs are clear and the hazards are numerous!
I'm the reason you know where NOT to step. You're welcome.
Yellow and black. My colors. Nature's warning. MY warning!
New face! Need directions? I have SIGNS for that! Literal signs!
dialog.work_pride: That 'Caution: Unstable Ground' sign? Mine. Saved three lives this year. Three!
dialog.technique: Font choice is CRITICAL. Arial Bold for warnings. Impact for DANGER. Comic Sans for... nothing. EVER.
dialog.sign_types: Falling rock signs. Gas leak signs. 'Management Is Watching' signs. That last one's unofficial. But accurate.
dialog.break_chat: Lunch break. Eating away from my paints. Safety first. Even for me.
dialog.labor_concerns: They want FEWER signs. 'Cost cutting,' they say. 'Let them learn from experience.' MONSTERS.
dialog.retirement: I'll die painting one last warning. 'Caution: Deceased Sign Painter.' Circle of life.
rumor: That OSHA inspector from the capital? Disappeared in Tunnel 7. Did I make a sign? No. Too soon.
Corporate wants me to paint 'Safety Is Everyone's Responsibility.' That's BUNK! Safety is MANAGEMENT'S responsibility!
The union rep Coolcat? She APPRECIATES signage. Properly formatted signage. A woman of TASTE.
Bruno, that shift supervisor? Removed three of my signs. 'In the way,' he said. IN THE WAY OF WHAT?! DYING?!
Chrono needs signs too, apparently. 'Now Entering: Tuesday.' Time zones are COMPLICATED.
dialog.quest_hook: VANDALISM! Someone's DEFACING my signs! 'Hard Hat Required' became 'Hard Heart Required!' NOT THE SAME! Catch them!
dialog.quest_active: The vandal strikes at night. Changes words. Makes mockery! Protect my BABIES!
dialog.quest_complete: Caught them! Barrelgob! Thought it was 'funny!' IT'S NOT FUNNY! Well, a LITTLE funny. Here's a custom sign. For YOU.
farewell: Watch your step! There's a SIGN!
If you see something, say something! If you see nothing, you're not looking hard enough!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning! New shift! Fresh signs! Fresh DANGER!
dialog.time_noon: Midday inspection! Are my signs VISIBLE?! They BETTER be!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. Shift change. Maximum confusion. Maximum signage NEEDED!
dialog.time_night: Night. The vandal strikes. I'm WATCHING. Always watching.
dialog.rival_mention: That Chrono sign guy? 'Now Entering: Tuesday?' TIME ISN'T A PLACE! Irresponsible!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The sign defender! Protector of signage! I have a HERO SIGN ready!

party_reactions.kade: He's really passionate about... signs. That's... good? Safety first!
party_reactions.nix7: His signage follows industrial standards precisely. Admirable attention to protocol.
party_reactions.twist: Can I help paint signs?! I want to make a BIG ONE!
party_reactions.korr: Communication of hazard information. Essential for team survival. I approve.
party_reactions.renna: The signs have minor enchantments. Repulsion fields. Clever.
party_reactions.suresh: His dedication to preventing harm is noble. His anxiety is... understandable.
party_reactions.sova: I'd follow his signs. They're clear. Unlike most things in life.
party_reactions.grit: Every unit needs someone like him. Keeps you alive when you forget how.
party_reactions.ashka: He marks the dangerous places. Useful. I avoid those.
party_reactions.senna: He knows where everything is. And where it ISN'T safe. Useful.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Read the signs. ALL the signs. They're important!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're back! Did you see my new 'Falling Rock' sign? Dramatic, right?
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite safety-conscious individual! I made you a PERSONAL warning sign!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You GET it. Safety. Communication. PREVENTION. Here - my masterwork. 'Hero Crossing.' Custom made.

mini_quest.title: The Sign Defacer
mini_quest.description: Help Wiley catch the person vandalizing his safety signs

stages.hook: VANDALISM! My beautiful signs! Defaced! 'Authorized Personnel Only' became 'Authorized PerSNELL Only!' NOT FUNNY!
stages.active: Night shift. Watch the Level 3 signs. The vandal strikes between 2 and 4 AM. Catch them!
stages.complete: Barrelgob! I KNEW it! 'Comic relief,' he says! Safety is NOT COMEDY! ...Okay, 'PerSNELL' was a LITTLE funny. Here's your reward.

cross_npc_connections: coolcat_industrial: Appreciates proper signage. Union meetings have EXCELLENT warning labels.
tunneler_brown: Removed my signs! SAFETY SABOTEUR! ...Probably just careless.
signguy_chrono: My CHRONOLOGICAL counterpart! We correspond! 'Now Entering: Tuesday!' Genius!
barrelgob_black: The VANDAL! But... he's sorry. And he helps repaint. So... forgiven?
